mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cms_resource_favorite (user_id, resource_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{resourceId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT resource_id FROM cms_resource_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.category_id, c.name AS category_name, a.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, a.attachment_name, a.attachment_ext, a.attachment_size, a.status, a.view_count, a.download_count, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.version FROM cms_resource_favorite f INNER JOIN cms_article a ON a.id = f.resource_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 2 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.author_id INNER JOIN cms_category c ON c.id = a.category_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
